parameters.query:
-- A workflow that stopped with an error. One that runs every few minutes is
-- reported on its second failure within an hour, so a network blip that
-- sorts itself out stays quiet; the others on the first. After that the team
-- hears again only about a different problem, or the same one after a day.
WITH failure AS (
    SELECT 'workflow:' || $1 AS key, $2::text AS subject, left($3::text, 2000) AS detail,
           -- the error without its numbers: a timeout after 180000 ms and one
           -- after 30000 ms are the same problem
           regexp_replace(lower(left($3::text, 300)), '[0-9]+', '#', 'g') AS problem,
           CASE WHEN $2::text IN ('Telegram capture', 'Collection schedule', 'Summarisation', 'Tagging')
                THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS needed
),
earlier AS (
    SELECT a.id, a.told_at, (a.told_at IS NULL AND a.last_seen < now() - interval '1 hour') AS stale
      FROM alerts a
      JOIN failure f ON f.key = a.key
     WHERE a.ended_at IS NULL
       FOR UPDATE OF a
),
updated AS (
    UPDATE alerts a
       SET last_seen = now(),
           times = CASE WHEN e.stale THEN 1 ELSE a.times + 1 END,
           started_at = CASE WHEN e.stale THEN now() ELSE a.started_at END,
           problem = f.problem,
           detail = f.detail,
           told_at = CASE
               WHEN a.told_at IS NULL
                    AND (CASE WHEN e.stale THEN 1 ELSE a.times + 1 END) >= f.needed THEN now()
               WHEN a.told_at IS NOT NULL
                    AND (a.problem IS DISTINCT FROM f.problem OR a.told_at < now() - interval '1 day') THEN now()
               ELSE a.told_at
           END
      FROM earlier e, failure f
     WHERE a.id = e.id
    RETURNING a.told_at IS DISTINCT FROM e.told_at AS tell, e.told_at IS NOT NULL AS again, a.times, a.started_at
),
inserted AS (
    INSERT INTO alerts (key, subject, problem, detail, told_at)
    SELECT f.key, f.subject, f.problem, f.detail, CASE WHEN f.needed <= 1 THEN now() END
      FROM failure f
     WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM earlier)
    ON CONFLICT (key) WHERE ended_at IS NULL DO NOTHING
    RETURNING told_at IS NOT NULL AS tell, false AS again, times, started_at
),
result AS (
    SELECT * FROM updated
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM inserted
)
SELECT coalesce((SELECT tell FROM result), false) AS tell,
       coalesce((SELECT again FROM result), false) AS again,
       (SELECT times FROM result) AS times,
       (SELECT started_at FROM result) AS since,
       $2::text AS workflow,
       $3::text AS error,
       (SELECT value FROM app_settings WHERE key = 'alert_chat_id') AS chat,
       coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(telegram_user_id ORDER BY id) FROM users
                  WHERE role = 'admin' AND removed_at IS NULL AND telegram_user_id IS NOT NULL), '[]') AS admins;

-- Sources whose last two checks both failed, or both found nothing, and
-- sources that work again. Each is reported once when it breaks and once when
-- it works again, never on every check. Also closes the alerts of sources
-- switched off since, and of workflows that have been quiet for six hours.
--
-- And the month's AI budget (db/init/24-ai-budget.sql): 80 % is reported once
-- a month, and a budget used up when it happens and when summarising starts
-- again, next month or because an admin raised it.
WITH runs AS (
    SELECT r.source_id, r.started_at, r.error, r.items_found,
           (r.error IS NOT NULL OR r.items_found = 0) AS bad,
           row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY r.source_id ORDER BY r.started_at DESC) AS n
      FROM collection_runs r
      JOIN sources s ON s.id = r.source_id
     WHERE s.active
       AND r.finished_at IS NOT NULL
       AND r.started_at > now() - interval '30 days'
),
good AS (
    SELECT source_id, max(started_at) AS at FROM runs WHERE NOT bad GROUP BY source_id
),
state AS (
    SELECT s.id, s.name, 'source:' || s.id AS key,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.n <= 2 AND r.bad) = 2 AS broken,
           bool_or(r.n = 1 AND NOT r.bad) AS works,
           coalesce(max(r.error) FILTER (WHERE r.n = 1), 'found nothing') AS detail,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.bad AND r.started_at > coalesce(g.at, '-infinity')) AS in_a_row
      FROM sources s
      JOIN runs r ON r.source_id = s.id
      LEFT JOIN good g ON g.source_id = s.id
     GROUP BY s.id, s.name, g.at
),
still AS (
    UPDATE alerts a
       SET last_seen = now(), times = st.in_a_row, detail = st.detail
      FROM state st
     WHERE a.key = st.key AND a.ended_at IS NULL AND st.broken
    RETURNING a.id
),
opened AS (
    INSERT INTO alerts (key, subject, detail, times, told_at)
    SELECT st.key, st.name, st.detail, st.in_a_row, now()
      FROM state st
     WHERE st.broken
       AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM alerts a WHERE a.key = st.key AND a.ended_at IS NULL)
    RETURNING subject, detail, times
),
fixed AS (
    UPDATE alerts a
       SET ended_at = now()
      FROM state st
     WHERE a.key = st.key AND a.ended_at IS NULL AND st.works
    RETURNING a.subject
),
budget AS (
    SELECT b.*, to_char(b.month_starts AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Helsinki', 'YYYY-MM') AS month
      FROM ai_budget b
),
budget_warned AS (
    INSERT INTO alerts (key, subject, detail, told_at, ended_at)
    SELECT 'budget:warn:' || b.month, 'AI budget', round(b.spent_eur, 2) || ' of ' || b.budget_eur, now(), now()
      FROM budget b
     WHERE b.warn AND NOT b.over
       AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM alerts a WHERE a.key = 'budget:warn:' || b.month)
    RETURNING id
),
budget_over AS (
    INSERT INTO alerts (key, subject, detail, told_at)
    SELECT 'budget:over', 'AI budget', round(b.spent_eur, 2) || ' of ' || b.budget_eur, now()
      FROM budget b
     WHERE b.over
       AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM alerts a WHERE a.key = 'budget:over' AND a.ended_at IS NULL)
    RETURNING id
),
budget_back AS (
    UPDATE alerts a
       SET ended_at = now()
     WHERE a.key = 'budget:over' AND a.ended_at IS NULL
       AND NOT (SELECT over FROM budget)
    RETURNING a.id
),
quiet AS (
    UPDATE alerts a
       SET ended_at = now()
     WHERE a.ended_at IS NULL
       AND ((a.key LIKE 'source:%' AND a.key NOT IN (SELECT 'source:' || id FROM sources WHERE active))
            OR (a.key LIKE 'workflow:%' AND a.last_seen < now() - interval '6 hours'))
    RETURNING a.id
)
SELECT coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('source', subject, 'error', detail, 'checks', times)
                                  ORDER BY subject) FROM opened), '[]') AS broken,
       coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(subject ORDER BY subject) FROM fixed), '[]') AS fixed,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM state) AS sources,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM state WHERE broken) AS broken_now,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM quiet) AS closed,
       (SELECT jsonb_build_object('warn', EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM budget_warned),
                                  'over', EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM budget_over),
                                  'back', EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM budget_back),
                                  'spent', b.spent_eur, 'budget', b.budget_eur, 'share', b.share,
                                  'next', (b.month_starts AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Helsinki' + interval '1 month')::date)
          FROM budget b) AS budget,
       (SELECT value FROM app_settings WHERE key = 'alert_chat_id') AS chat,
       coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(telegram_user_id ORDER BY id) FROM users
                  WHERE role = 'admin' AND removed_at IS NULL AND telegram_user_id IS NOT NULL), '[]') AS admins;
